text:
laura: PR #19102 is green locally but CI is getting stuck on the mac unit matrix (flaky test). I need a short rebase/merge window before the deploy blackout at 18:00 PT — anyone able to give 15m? :pray:

matt: what exactly is failing in CI? test name / failure snippet?

laura: failing `TestKVCacheEviction` on mac. It flaked twice in a row on the mac/unit job. Logs uploaded to the PR (link omitted). I can rebase & force-push if we can run a targeted retry.

deploy-bot: Pipeline update: mac/unit failed (flaky test). To retry: `/ci retry 19102` or trigger job `mac/unit` from the pipeline UI.

jordan: I can help. If you rebase and push, I can trigger `ci retry --jobs=mac/unit` and watch the run. Also adding myself as quick reviewer to unblock approvals. :eyes:

laura: doing the rebase now: `git pull --rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease` — will ping when done.

laura: pushed. pinging for mac/unit retry.

matt: kicked off the retry, queue time ~10-15m. If it flakes again we should consider landing a hotfix with a canary and short monitoring window instead of waiting through the entire CI queue. Thoughts?

sre-oncall: temporary bypass + canary is acceptable for a critical hotfix, but require: 1) explicit canary rollout (10% traffic), 2) alert on error rate / latency, 3) documented rollback steps. If those are in place, +1.

laura: canary enabled and dashboard pinned (link omitted). I'll watch for the next 20m and report back. If green, requesting manual merge before 18:00 PT.

matt: watching. If we get green, I'll do a manual merge & tag canary. If anything flakes ping me directly.
